internship.title: Data Engineering Virtual Internship
internship.summary: A structured virtual internship covering end-to-end data engineering and cloud infrastructure fundamentals using AWS — bridging classroom theory with real-world system design.
highlights: Data Pipelines & ETL — designed and understood data ingestion, transformation, and storage workflows, applying Extract–Transform–Load patterns and data-cleaning techniques.
AWS Core Services — hands-on with Amazon S3, EC2, Lambda (serverless), and RDS, applying scalability, high availability, fault tolerance, and cost optimisation.
Cloud Networking — VPC architecture, routing, secure service communication, subnetting and supernetting for IP allocation and traffic control.
IAM & Access Control — implemented Identity and Access Management to enforce secure authentication and role-based authorisation across cloud services.

projects.name: ElementalUI
projects.description: A visually engaging and fully searchable periodic table. Click any element to view detailed properties, filter by category, and explore the building blocks of matter.

projects.name: Library Management System
projects.description: A terminal and MySQL Workbench based system to manage library operations — book records, reader records, employee records, issuing and returning books, view issue history — built with JDBC connectivity.

projects.name: Bibliogram
projects.description: A full-stack Library Management System with role-based authentication for Admin, Member, and Reader. Features book catalog management, issue/return workflows with automated fine calculation, and separate dashboards per role.
projects.deployment: Local · Apache Tomcat 11, DB · MySQL Workbench

projects.name: LeafScan
projects.description: A crop disease detection and fertilizer recommendation system. Farmers upload a leaf photo, a fine-tuned EfficientNetB0 model identifies the disease, and a rule-based engine returns fertilizer, fungicide, organic alternatives, and recovery time — with full detection history saved per user.
projects.deployment: Frontend → Vercel, Backend → Render, DB → MongoDB Atlas
